s.x: I was Dx'd with ADHD ten years ago.

s.g: (radio) Long-distance contact with or reception of a distant radio station.
(radio) To receive and identify a long-distance broadcast, such as one by a distant AM, FM, or TV broadcast station.
(amateur radio) To complete a long-distance two-way radio information exchange, especially on amateur radio bands.
The hobby of receiving and identifying distant radio or television signals, or making two-way radio contact with distant stations.
